hypothesis: Theorems TA-1 and TA-2 (paper papers/theory_atlas/paper.md) predict, on the 4-bit Boolean world with three context subsets U_1={x_0=0}, U_2={x_1=0}, U_3={x_2=0}, chart maps M_1(x)=g(x), M_2(x)=(g(x)+1) mod 4, M_3(x)=(g(x)+2) mod 4 for g(x)=(2*x_2+x_3) mod 4, and target label space T=Z/4, that (i) the good transitions T_12=+1, T_23=+1, T_13=+2 satisfy the cocycle T_23 ∘ T_12 = T_13 on the single triple (1,2,3) and glue to the global theory M=g; (ii) the bad transitions T_12=+1, T_23=+1, T_13=+3 violate the cocycle with rank-4 discrepancy (shift-by-3 on Z/4) and do not glue; and (iii) the bad-family failure has the missing-latent signature (rank >= 1 with all three T_ij non-identity), distinct from the phase-transition signature (rank >= 1 with exactly one T_ij non-identity) exhibited by a reference family (T_12=+1, T_23=id, T_13=id).

gates.TAP_TA1_GOOD_CHARTS_SATISFY_COCYCLE: For the good chart family, the cocycle T_jk ∘ T_ij = T_ik holds on every triple (i,j,k) with pairwise overlap (cocycle_discrepancy = identity permutation on T).
gates.TAP_TA1_BAD_CHARTS_VIOLATE_COCYCLE: For the bad chart family, at least one triple (i,j,k) has non-zero cocycle discrepancy (rank >= 1 on T).
gates.TAP_TA1_GLUE_IFF_COCYCLE: The pivot-through-chart-1 gluing attempt is consistent for the good family (single-valued global M on U_1 ∪ U_2 ∪ U_3) and inconsistent for the bad family (some world in a pairwise overlap receives at least two distinct candidate values).
gates.TAP_TA2_BAD_DISCREPANCY_MATCHES_MISSING_: The bad family is classified as 'missing_latent' by Theorem TA-2's rank/support rule (cocycle fails and every pairwise T_ij is non-identity), the phase_boundary_reference family is classified as 'phase_transition' (cocycle fails and exactly one T_ij is non-identity), and the good family is classified as 'glue'.

compute.sampling: exact enumeration of the 16-element Boolean world and the 4-element target alphabet; no Monte Carlo.
